title: MonaChat VR
tagline: Bringing blockchain assets to life powered by the Mona Unity SDK! Chat and interact with all your favorite digital assets.

prizes.title: Best implementation of MONA’s SDK for a gaming environment.

description:
🌟 Don't you wish you could do more with your digital assets than just look at them on a 2D screen? Imagine stepping into a vibrant virtual world where your digital assets come to life! 🎉

With MonaChat VR, you can interact with your digital collectibles just like physical objects. 🤩 Engage in conversations with iconic artworks, explore detailed 3D models, and immerse yourself in an interactive VR environment that blends technology and artistry. 🎨🖼️

MonaChat VR transforms your digital assets into dynamic, living entities, providing a unique and engaging experience that goes beyond mere ownership. 🚀✨ Step into the future of digital interaction with MonaChat VR and make your virtual world more exciting and fun! 🌈🕶️🎮
how_its_made:
### Tech Stack

- **👜 Mona Unity Wallet SDK**: Used to obtain collectibles from Mona and their .glb files, enabling integration of digital assets into the VR environment.
- **💬 Gemini API**: Provides AI-powered responses, enhancing interactivity by allowing users to chat with their digital assets.
- **🎮 Unity Engine**: Renders 3D objects in a VR environment and simulates real-time physics and physical interactions, creating an immersive and interactive experience.
- **🗣️ Meta Voice SDK**: Enables text-to-speech (TTS) and speech-to-text (SST) functionalities, bringing your digital assets to life with voice interactions.
- **🤲 Meta Interactable SDK**: Facilitates grabbing and physical manipulation of objects, making interactions with digital assets more intuitive and realistic.
